title: About the Ada site
description: How this humorous Ada Lovelace website was made, who its author Miroslav Reiter is, and where to find IT Academy, VITA and his profiles.
intro: Programming history, curiosity and humour at the same table. This is the story of a website that even sent Ada Lovelace to the beach with a laptop.
tagline: Made with ideas, code and a little strong tea.
author.label: Author and concept creator
author.photoAlt: Miroslav Reiter, author of the Ada website
author.bio: Miroslav Reiter is a lecturer and founder of IT Academy and the VITA learning platform. His work focuses on practical education in IT, marketing and management.
author.source: More about the author on VITA
author.research: His research explores digital transformation, gamification and online learning, connecting academic knowledge with practice.
profiles.title: Where to find me
profiles.intro: Courses, videos, professional connections and research in one place.
profile.youtube: Miroslav Reiter - VITA Academy. Videos and course previews.
production.title: How this website was made
production.intro: The site grows through collaboration between Miroslav Reiter and the AI tools ChatGPT and Codex. Miroslav sets the purpose, content and direction; AI assists with design, writing, translation, programming and checks.
step1.title: An idea with a spark
step1.text: Introduce Ada Lovelace clearly and with humour. Her historical biography gained some unusual company: imaginary startups, a modern CV and tea-powered programming.
step2.title: Content you can try
step2.text: The portfolio grew to include a quiz, time machine, punched cards, advice, newspaper and gallery. Visitors can explore, click and learn at their own pace.
step3.title: Five languages, one salon
step3.text: Slovak is the default language. The entire site is also available in Czech, English, German and Spanish, with light, dark and system appearance modes and reading preferences.
step4.title: Test, refine, save
step4.text: We check updates on desktop and mobile, including links and controls. Finished versions are published through Sites, with source files backed up on GitHub.
technology.title: Under the bonnet
technology.text: The pages use HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Python generates the language editions from shared templates. You can explore the code and supporting files in the repository.
principles.title: Facts have sources. Humour has a home.
facts.title: Historical facts
facts.text: Information about Ada is grounded in the cited sources. Links to historical documents, museums and books are collected in a dedicated source library.
fiction.title: Clearly labelled fiction
fiction.text: TeaScript, Steam Cloud, the modern CV and salon jokes are creative fiction. They are not Ada's real inventions, quotations or work experience.
images.title: Portraits and AI imagination
images.text: Historical portraits include their provenance. Modern beach scenes are AI-generated images labelled as fiction. They are not historical photographs.
access.title: Comfortable without a magnifying glass
access.text: We consider readability, contrast, mobile layouts and keyboard use as we make changes. The site is tested and improved over time; this is not a claim of full WCAG certification.
closing: Ada was ahead of her time. We are trying to keep this website up to speed with your phone.
